title: Integration of Artificial Intelligence in Educational Measurement: Efficacy of ChatGPT in Data Generation within the Scope of Item Response Theory
reasoning: The paper discusses the general societal and academic implications of AI, including potential for academic misconduct or spreading misinformation. However, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking an LLM's performance on tasks specifically related to religion, morals, or ethics. The core focus is on data generation efficacy and IRT assumptions.
